glossary.Obesity: Excess body fat that harms health, defined as BMI 30 or more.
glossary.kg/m²: Units of BMI: weight in kilograms divided by height in metres squared.
glossary.Down syndrome: Trisomy 21, a chromosomal condition with learning disability and higher obesity risk.
glossary.Hypothyroidism: Underactive thyroid, which slows metabolism and causes weight gain.
glossary.Comorbidity: Another illness present at the same time, such as diabetes or hypertension.
glossary.CVD: Cardiovascular disease: heart attack, stroke and vessel disease.
glossary.Adipose tissue: Body fat tissue, which stores energy and releases hormones.
glossary.HbA1c: Glycated haemoglobin, showing average blood glucose over about 3 months.
glossary.LFTs: Liver function tests, used here to look for fatty liver.
glossary.Lipid profile: Blood test of cholesterol fractions and triglycerides.
glossary.Triglyceride: The main storage form of fat: glycerol plus three fatty acids.
glossary.Hydrolysis: Breaking a molecule apart using water, as lipase does to triglycerides.
glossary.Glucagon: Pancreatic hormone that raises blood glucose; suppressed by GLP-1.
glossary.Gastric emptying: The rate food leaves the stomach for the small intestine.
glossary.Glucose-dependent insulin secretion: Insulin released only when glucose is high, so GLP-1 drugs rarely cause hypoglycaemia alone.
glossary.Appetite centre: Areas of the hypothalamus that control hunger and fullness.
glossary.Intra-abdominal pressure: Pressure inside the abdomen, raised by central fat.
glossary.Gut hormones: Hormones released by the gut after eating that affect insulin and appetite, such as GLP-1 and PYY.
glossary.Satiety: The feeling of fullness that stops eating.
glossary.Calorie deficit: Eating fewer calories than the body uses, leading to weight loss.
glossary.Relapse prevention: Strategies to stop weight being regained after it is lost.
glossary.Gestation: The length of pregnancy, counted in weeks.
glossary.Low-dose aspirin: 75 to 150mg aspirin daily, used in pregnancy to lower pre-eclampsia risk.
glossary.Pre-eclampsia: Pregnancy hypertension with organ damage such as proteinuria; obesity raises the risk.
glossary.Pack-years: Packs smoked per day times years smoked, a measure of smoking exposure.
glossary.Heterozygous: Carrying one copy of a gene variant, inherited from one parent.
glossary.VTE: Venous thromboembolism: DVT or pulmonary embolism.
glossary.Specialist weight management service: A multidisciplinary NHS service for complex obesity, including assessment for surgery.
glossary.Titrate: Increase a drug dose step by step to the target dose.
